SK9002 The effective configuration draws from an .editorconfig above the repository root

An .editorconfig outside the repository is in the chain Skala resolved, so the effective configuration depends on a file the repository does not contain. Add root = true to the repository's top .editorconfig to stop the walk there; skala config fix adds it.

CategoryTool
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.1

Why

The Rider export ships without root = true, so the walk up from a source file keeps going past the repository, and a stray ~/.editorconfig silently joins the chain — the same tree then formats differently on two machines. It is reported once per outside file, and it fires even when that file contributed nothing, because the report is about the chain's shape rather than about a value in force: the detail names the keys that came from it, or says that none did. If the inherited keys are wanted, copy them down into the repository's own file.

When it does not fire

Only skala config check reports it, because only check knows where the repository starts; config explain is silent on the same tree unless given --root. The test is an ordinal path-prefix comparison on the directory, so an .editorconfig in a sibling directory whose name extends the root's — /repo against /repository — is treated as inside and is not reported.
